newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seven percent in UIS traded in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Seven percent in UIS traded in Paris.

text.p: A block trade representing some seven percent in property firm UIS was traded on Thursday morning but the company was not immediately available for comment.
"We have been contacted by the SBF (Paris Bourse) to inform us about the block trade but I am not in a position to give you any comment," a UIS employee said.
The block trade of 1.036 million shares in the Union Pour Le Financement de l'Immeuble de Societes (UIS) took place at 170 francs per share immediately after the opening.
UIS is indirectly controlled by insurer GAN, which has 13.39 percent via its Gan Incendie Accidents unit, 29.55 percent through GAN Vie and 40.17 percent via UIC.
Traders said the transaction could be between two of the GAN groups' units for fiscal reasons at the end of the year.
